title: Complete the 0.4-required compiler structural split wave
body:
The 0.4-required structural wave is complete for semantic_contract, beskid_isle, beskid_pckg_store, canonical Runtime/Mem/Gc, TypeChecker expressions, and codegen module emission. The remaining manifest/codegen, community-route, heap, document-service, assembly-loader, shell-host, and call-expression splits are structural/LOC cleanup without a normative 0.4 release obligation. The accepted 0.4 boundary moves that residual work beyond 0.4 unless a new bounded issue proves a concrete correctness, authority, testability, legacy-deletion, or release-gate dependency. No compatibility duplicate is authorized.

**Linear:** [CYB-183](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-183/v04-split-remaining-mixed-responsibility-compiler-monoliths) records the completed wave and canceled residual 0.4 scope; [CYB-193](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-193/decide-which-remaining-compiler-monolith-splits-belong-in-04) records the accepted boundary rule.

subtasks.text: Move residual structural-only splits beyond 0.4 unless a concrete gate dependency is proven
Preserve the no-compatibility-duplicate rule for any future bounded split
